thesis: The episode discusses the potential for faster regulatory approval of updated mRNA vaccines based on new variants by substituting large clinical trials with smaller non-inferiority studies supplemented by immunogenicity and in vitro data. It argues that while current vaccines maintain good efficacy against existing strains, future vaccine strategies may need to pivot to new variant backbones to address emerging threats of partial immune escape.
